in_hebrew.name: Tadeusz
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Thaddeus: Attachment, Love
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tadeusz הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Thaddeus is a Polish name derived from the Aramaic name Addai, which means 'love, kindness'. In the New Testament, Thaddeus is one of the 12 apostles, also known as Judas son of James, who preached the Gospel in various parts of Asia.

in_greek.name: Tadeusz
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Thaddeus: Attachment, Love
in_greek.long_meaning: Tadeusz είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Thaddeus is a Polish name derived from the Aramaic name Addai, which means 'love, kindness'. In the New Testament, Thaddeus is one of the 12 apostles, also known as Judas son of James, who preached the Gospel in various parts of Asia.

in_latin.name: Tadeus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen originis Hebraici 'Taḏdāy' significat 'corona' vel 'diadema'. In Novo Testamento, Tadeus est unus discipulorum Domini, qui est nominatus in Matthaeo 10:3, Lucae 6:16, et Actis 1:13. Nomen 'Tadeus' est etymologicus originis Hebraicae, unde et nomen Latinum 'Tadeus' derivatum est. In traditione Christiana, nomen 'Tadeus' significat fidelitatem, constantiam, et honor. Nomen 'Tadeus' etiam est nomen masculinum, quod in variis culturis Christianis usitatum est.
